turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Chris Bellamy, thanks for having me out today to look at your HVAC system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for coming, come on in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: So tell me, what's prompting you to look into this now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We're just comparing a few places before we decide.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: For the package we discussed, the total cost is $980/month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's a bit more than I expected, it feels too expensive.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I understand, it is an investment. We do have financing options if that helps.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Why don't I send over the paperwork and we can follow up in a few days?
